subject: Final loop: Platform SWE — logistics, Zoom & accessibility confirmation
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee+candidate@gmail.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Availability for final loop — Platform SWE

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for interviewing with Redwood. We'd like to schedule your final on-site loop (virtual) for the Platform SWE role. The loop will be four interviews (architecture, systems design, two coding rounds) and a 30-minute hiring manager conversation. Total time ~3 hours including two short breaks.

Can you confirm whether any of the following slots work for you?
- Tue Oct 6: 9:30–12:30 PT
- Wed Oct 7: 10:00–13:00 PT
- Thu Oct 8: 13:00–16:00 PT

Also: do you have any accessibility requirements (captioning, extended breaks, screen-reader-friendly docs) we should arrange? We can provide live captions and a 10-minute break between rounds on request.

If one of those works, we’ll lock it and send the Zoom link + agenda and panel prep. Attaching a draft agenda and your resume we have on file.

Thanks —
Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Recruiter, Technical Hiring
Redwood Inference

Attachments: platform_swe_loop_agenda.pdf, candidate_resume_jordan_lee.pdf

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee+candidate@gmail.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Availability for final loop — Platform SWE

Hi Laura —

Thanks — Wed Oct 7 10:00–13:00 PT works best. I’d like live captioning for the session and two 10-minute rests between interview pairs if possible (I have a chronic vocal fatigue condition). Also, could the interview prompts be shared as plain text ahead of time? Screen-reader compatibility is important for me.

If you need any documentation for the accommodations, happy to provide it. Appreciate the flexibility.

Best,
Jordan

Team —

Jordan confirmed Wed Oct 7 10:00–13:00 PT for the final loop. Candidate requested:
- Live captioning for the entire session (AccessNow will provide captions)
- Two 10-minute breaks between rounds
- Interview materials in plain-text/accessible format beforehand

Zoom link / passcode (please join 5–10 min early for mic/camera checks):
Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=redwood123
Passcode: RW-Loop-2026

Attached: final agenda (platform_swe_loop_agenda.pdf) and Jordan's resume. I've looped AccessNow to confirm captions — @support, please confirm on this thread and share any onboarding steps (API key? join link?).

Panel assignments:
- 10:00–10:40: Systems design — Mina Haddad
- 10:50–11:30: Coding #1 — Vivek Kulkarni (pairing)
- 11:40–12:20: Coding #2 — Tessa Morgan
- 12:20–12:50: Hiring manager — Tessa Morgan

Notes: Please prepare plain-text prompts and upload them to the SharePoint prep folder linked below. Also add a 10-minute buffer after 10:40 and 11:30 for the candidate's breaks (calendar invites reflect this).

Related links: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/hiring/platform-swe-loop-prep

Thanks —
Laura

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirmed: Wed Oct 7 10:00–13:00 PT (Jordan Lee) — panel prep

Thanks Laura — all clear. A couple quick asks for the panel: 

1) Vivek — can you lead the architecture portion and include a 8–10 minute whiteboard on cross-region replication? We want to see trade-offs you push candidates on.
2) Mina — please have the systems design prompt in plain text in the SharePoint folder by EOD Mon Oct 5.
3) All interviewers — please populate quick scoring rubrics in the prep doc (1–4 scale) and note any specific signals you’ll prioritize (operational concerns, latency tradeoffs, design for failure).

We’ll meet for a 20-minute debrief at 14:00 PT on Oct 7 (same day) — calendar invite sent by Laura. Vivek, if you can reserve ~10 minutes at the top of your coding slot to confirm IDE/setup for pairing, that would help.

Thanks —
Tessa

- Mute when not speaking
